name: quartet-cluster-ostinato
style: contemporary chamber horror, solo string quartet only (two violins, viola, cello), close-miked and dry, small room. Cello repeats a quiet four-note figure that climbs a step each time, soft and even like creeping footsteps. Above it the violins and viola hold tight tremolo clusters, a semitone apart, gritty near the bridge, gliding slowly upward. Every few seconds all four players strike one hard accented clashing chord together, then a beat of dead silence, then the cello figure creeps back in. Harmony never settles; the final chord is the harshest clash, cut off dead. Slow, sparse, tense, instrumental
exclude: epic, trailer, braam, hybrid, orchestral, drums, percussion, synth, choir, vocals, piano
